premises.text: Physical-world businesses rely on bills/receipts as cost truth and must validate, code, and enter each bill
premises.evidence_span: bills and receipts are the source of truth for your costs

premises.text: Complex bill formats plus disconnected approvers make hygienic AP fail under manual entry
premises.evidence_span: bills are hard. Some are very long. Others are structurally complex

premises.text: Spatial mapping and language models extract and reconcile tens of thousands of bill data points
premises.evidence_span: We extract more than 50,000 data points from every page

premises.text: Contextualized workflow routes approvers, suggests job coding, syncs accounting, and pays with discount capture
premises.evidence_span: a single click approves the bill, auto-creates the associated record in the accounting system

value.text: Effortless, accurate accounts-payable operations with better cost data
